# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 1: Eurasian AI Logic Overhaul (oe_ai2_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_v99_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# O(1) annual AI Macro-Steward effects for Project Phoenix (OEBYZ) v9.9.
# Zero free resources: every reform/Chao/Haiyun action pays exact player authority or gold costs.

oe_ai2_annual_macro_steward = {
	oe_ai2_sync_corridors = yes
	oe_ai2_sync_personality = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = BYZ
				tag = ROM
			}
		}
		oe_ai2_steward_byz = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = CHI
				tag = MNG
				tag = MCH
			}
		}
		oe_ai2_steward_china = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = MOS
				tag = RUS
			}
		}
		oe_ai2_steward_rus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = TUR
				tag = MAM
				tag = POL
				tag = PLC
			}
		}
		oe_ai2_steward_eurasia_majors = yes
	}
}

# 1. Dynamic Strategic Corridor Assignment (pure O(1) preference toggles)
oe_ai2_sync_corridors = {
	# BYZ / ROM: Balkans -> Anatolia -> Levant/Italy
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = BYZ
				tag = ROM
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_balkans } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_balkans
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_anatolia } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_anatolia
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1450
				country_rank_level >= 3
				NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_levant_egypt }
			}
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_levant_egypt
		}
	}

	# TUR: Anatolia + Balkans -> Levant
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = TUR }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_anatolia } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_anatolia
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_balkans } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_balkans
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1460
				NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_levant_egypt }
			}
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_levant_egypt
		}
	}

	# SER / BUL: Balkan corridor + anti-northern-snake deterrent
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = SER
				tag = BUL
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_balkans } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_balkans
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_balkan_overreach } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_balkan_overreach
		}
	}

	# MAM: Levant & Egypt corridor
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = MAM }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_levant_egypt } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_levant_egypt
		}
	}

	# VEN / GEN: Italy & maritime nodes + inland mountain deterrent
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = VEN
				tag = GEN
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_italy_maritime } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_italy_maritime
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_inland_balkan_gore } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_inland_balkan_gore
		}
	}

	# MOS / RUS / NOV: 3-stage Rus Heartland -> Volga/Baltic -> Siberia
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = MOS
				tag = RUS
				tag = NOV
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_rus_heartland } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_rus_heartland
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1430
				NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_rus_volga_baltic }
			}
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_rus_volga_baltic
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1520
				NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_siberia_east }
			}
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_siberia_east
		}
	}

	# POL / PLC / HUN: deter deep steppe snake
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = POL
				tag = PLC
				tag = HUN
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_steppe_snake } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_steppe_snake
		}
	}

	# GLH: Pontic-Steppe corridor
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = GLH }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_pontic_steppe } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_pontic_steppe
		}
	}

	# CHI / MNG: China core + highland deterrent (lifted after 1550 once stable)
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = CHI
				tag = MNG
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_china_core } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_china_core
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year < 1550
				NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_china_highlands }
			}
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_china_highlands
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1550
				has_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_china_highlands
			}
			remove_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_china_highlands
		}
	}

	# MCH: Manchuria & Liaodong -> China core
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = MCH }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_manchuria_liaodong } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_manchuria_liaodong
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_china_highlands } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_deter_china_highlands
		}
	}

	# TIM / IRA: Persia & Central Asia corridor
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = TIM
				tag = IRA
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_persia_central_asia } }
			add_area_preference = oe_ai2_corridor_persia_central_asia
		}
	}
}

# 2. Dynamic Fiscal & Strategic Personality Sync (respects random personality & hegemon rules)
oe_ai2_sync_personality = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_game_rule = ai_personalities_random }
			NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = yes
				ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity
			}
			set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = no
				war_exhaustion < 6
				OR = {
					ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init }
				}
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
			if = {
				limit = { oe_ai2_is_maritime_profile = yes }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_maritime_power
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_ai2_is_steppe_profile = yes }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_steppe_khanate
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_ai2_is_continental_profile = yes }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_continental_empire
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. AI Byzantium (BYZ / ROM) Macro-Steward: Court Offices, Reforms, Theme Houses & Cultural Law
oe_ai2_steward_byz = {
	# 3a. Staff Byzantine Imperial Court Offices via existing oe_court_auto_fill
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = BYZ
			oe_court_offices_active = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_court_auto_enabled } }
			set_variable = oe_court_auto_enabled
		}
		oe_court_auto_fill = yes
	}

	# 3b. Enact Imperial Reforms sequentially using exact player Imperial Authority cost (-50)
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = BYZ
			at_war = no
			exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				has_variable = oe_pillars_authority
				var:oe_pillars_authority >= 65
			}
		}
		# Priority 1: Coinage Reform (oe_ir_coinage)
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_coinage_done } }
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -50 }
			}
			set_variable = oe_ir_coinage_done
			location:thessaloniki = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = {
							OR = {
								this = root
								is_subject_or_below_of = root
							}
						}
						has_town_rights = town_rights_type:oe_rights_thessaloniki_mint
					}
					revoke_town_rights_of_type = town_rights_type:oe_rights_thessaloniki_mint
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:oe_rights_imperial_mint } }
						grant_town_rights = town_rights_type:oe_rights_imperial_mint
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_byz_empier_money_gII }
				unlock_policy_effect = { type = oe_hyperpyron_coinage }
				add_policy = policy:oe_hyperpyron_coinage
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_abolish_hyperpyron months = 24 mode = replace }
				unlock_policy_effect = { type = stavraton_coin_policy }
				add_policy = policy:stavraton_coin_policy
			}
		}
		# Priority 2: Imperial Offices Reform (oe_ir_offices)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_offices_done }
				current_ruler_term_years > 10
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -50 }
			}
			set_variable = oe_ir_offices_done
			oe_ir_upgrade_court_reform = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_rule_area }
				revoke_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_noble_rule_area
			}
		}
		# Priority 3: Imperial Law Reform (oe_ir_law) once centralized
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_ir_central_done
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_law_done }
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -50 }
			}
			set_variable = oe_ir_law_done
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ir_law_modifier years = -1 mode = replace }
		}
		# Priority 4: Imperial Faith Reform (oe_ir_faith) once centralized
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_ir_central_done
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ir_faith_done }
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -50 }
			}
			set_variable = oe_ir_faith_done
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ir_faith_modifier years = -1 mode = replace }
		}
	}

	# 3c. Adopt Imperial Cultural Integration Law policy when none active
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = oe_cul_imperial_integration_law
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_classical_assimilation }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_federated_millet }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_scholarly_syncretism }
		}
		add_policy = policy:oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism
	}
}

# 4. AI Great Yuan (CHI) / Ming (MNG) / Manchu (MCH) Macro-Steward: Chao, Haiyun Grain & Laws
oe_ai2_steward_china = {
	# 4a. Great Yuan Chao currency stabilization (pays real gold, 3-year cooldown)
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CHI
			has_global_variable = oe_yc_on
			has_global_variable = oe_yc_cred
			global_var:oe_yc_cred < 0
			at_war = no
			gold >= 300
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai2_yc_cd }
		}
		add_gold = -150
		oe_yc_add_trust = { amount = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ai2_yc_cd months = 36 }
	}

	# 4b. Great Yuan Haiyun maritime grain replenishment (pays real gold, 3-year cooldown)
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CHI
			has_global_variable = oe_yh_on
			has_global_variable = oe_yh_grain
			global_var:oe_yh_grain < 180
			gold >= 250
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ai2_yh_cd }
		}
		add_gold = -120
		oe_yh_add_grain = { amount = 45 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ai2_yh_cd months = 36 }
	}

	# 4c. Eastern Imperial Religious Policy (v9.6 oe_rel_imperial_religious_policy)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = oe_rel_imperial_religious_policy
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_rel_policy_sanjiao_balance }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_rel_policy_xuanzheng_lama }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_rel_policy_hui_astronomers }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_rel_policy_orthodox_confucian_strict }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = MNG }
			add_policy = policy:oe_rel_policy_orthodox_confucian_strict
		}
		else = {
			add_policy = policy:oe_rel_policy_sanjiao_balance
		}
	}

	# 4d. Imperial Cultural Integration Law policy
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = oe_cul_imperial_integration_law
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_classical_assimilation }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_federated_millet }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_scholarly_syncretism }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { tag = MNG }
			add_policy = policy:oe_cul_policy_classical_assimilation
		}
		else = {
			add_policy = policy:oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism
		}
	}
}

# 5. AI Russia (MOS / RUS) Macro-Steward: Frontier Integration Law
oe_ai2_steward_rus = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = oe_cul_imperial_integration_law
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_classical_assimilation }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_federated_millet }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_scholarly_syncretism }
		}
		add_policy = policy:oe_cul_policy_classical_assimilation
	}
}

# 6. AI Ottomans (TUR), Mamluks (MAM), Poland (POL / PLC) Macro-Steward
oe_ai2_steward_eurasia_majors = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = oe_cul_imperial_integration_law
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_classical_assimilation }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_federated_millet }
			NOT = { has_policy = oe_cul_policy_scholarly_syncretism }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tag = TUR
					tag = MAM
				}
			}
			add_policy = policy:oe_cul_policy_federated_millet
		}
		else = {
			add_policy = policy:oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism
		}
	}
}
